kjv.text: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

web.text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

kjv.text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

web.text: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kjv.text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

web.text: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

kjv.text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

web.text: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

kjv.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

web.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,* or, faithfulness

kjv.text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

web.text: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

kjv.text: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

web.text: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

kjv.text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

web.text: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

kjv.text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

web.text: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

kjv.text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

web.text: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

kjv.text: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

web.text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

kjv.text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

web.text: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

kjv.text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

web.text: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

kjv.text: For every man shall bear his own burden.

web.text: For each man will bear his own burden.

kjv.text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

web.text: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

kjv.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

web.text: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

kjv.text: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

web.text: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

kjv.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

web.text: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

kjv.text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

web.text: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

kjv.text: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

web.text: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

kjv.text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

web.text: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised; just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

kjv.text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

web.text: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

kjv.text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

web.text: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

kjv.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

web.text: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

kjv.text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

web.text: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

kjv.text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

web.text: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

kjv.text: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

web.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
